sections.name: Hero
sections.description: Full viewport height. Background image of a bride with a heavy dark gradient overlay (`bg-black/60`). Content centered. Big bold heading 'Your Beauty, Our Passion' in gold gradient text. CTA buttons: 'Book Now' and 'WhatsApp'.

sections.name: Why Choose Us
sections.description: Grid layout highlighting Experience, Happy Clients, Premium Products. Minimal icons (lucide-react), gold accents. Use simple `cards.base`.

sections.name: Services
sections.description: Bento grid or cards for Hair, Facial, Waxing, Makeup, Bridal, Hair Spa. Use subtle hover effects where borders glow gold. Include relevant images from the media section.

sections.name: Bridal Packages
sections.description: Pricing tier cards (₹7999–₹25000). Highlight the 'Most Popular' package with a gold border (`cards.premium`), slight scale up (`md:scale-105`), and 'Most Popular' badge. Show urgency line 'Limited slots for upcoming wedding season'.

sections.name: Gallery
sections.description: Masonry or standard grid gallery of bridal and salon images. Instagram CTA link at the bottom.

sections.name: Testimonials
sections.description: Grid of 5-star reviews. Use gold star icons. Clean minimalistic cards.

sections.name: Pricing
sections.description: Clean list or simple simple table layout with starting prices for generic services ('starting from ₹...').

sections.name: Contact & Booking
sections.description: Split section: Left side contact details (phone, address, timings) + Google Map embed. Right side Booking form (Name, Phone, Service, Date) that opens WhatsApp pre-filled upon submission.

sections.name: Sticky Bottom Bar
sections.description: Mobile only (`md:hidden`). Fixed at bottom `fixed bottom-0 w-full z-50`. Actions: Call, WhatsApp, Book. Glassmorphism background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the application uses `lucide-react` for icons. Add Playfair Display and Outfit to Tailwind font families. Prioritize mobile layout first since the primary traffic will be mobile users seeking bookings. WhatsApp integrations must be simple `href='https://wa.me/917733079941?text=...'` links. The booking form should capture details and dynamically generate a WhatsApp message link with the pre-filled text instead of a traditional backend submission. Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements (buttons, links, forms). Never use placeholder images. Follow the colors rigorously. Add a floating WhatsApp button as well `fixed bottom-20 right-4`.
